Name: Jalter over Abigail
Author: aj0089733234
Description:
Basically replaces Abigail portraits and sprites with Joan d arc (Alter) from Fate/Grand Order. There are 2 mods you need the first one has the portraits form Spring, Summer and Fall and the sprites for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter. The second mod is for portraiture and gives the winter portrait. (Abigail winter would not work with the first mod). If anyone does wanna compile it all into one hmu and I'll send the original thing with all of them and see if you can figure it out. 

For now put the first file in Mods folder.

Then for the second mod you'll need the Portraiture and PyTK mod and put those into your mods folder. You'll then have to take the "WINTER - Joan Arc" folder and paste it into the portraits folder of the Portraiture mod.



ART BY AKIRO ART
